authoritative_commands: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .

set -euo pipefail
cd macos
export DEVELOPER_DIR="/Applications/Xcode_26.5.app/Contents/Developer"
test -x "$DEVELOPER_DIR/usr/bin/xcodebuild"
test "$(xcodebuild -version | sed -n '1p')" = "Xcode 26.5"
xcodegen generate --spec project.yml
xcodebuild build-for-testing \
-project BluRayToVisionPro.xcodeproj \
-scheme BDToAVPPlayer \
-configuration Debug \
-destination "generic/platform=visionOS Simulator" \
-derivedDataPath build/BDToAVPPlayerDerivedData \
CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
runtime_id="$(xcrun simctl list runtimes -j | jq -r '
[.runtimes[]
| select(.isAvailable == true)
| select(.platform == "visionOS" or (.name | startswith("visionOS")))
| select((.version | split(".")[0] | tonumber) >= 26)
| .identifier]
| first // empty
')"
device_type_id="$(xcrun simctl list devicetypes -j | jq -r '
[.devicetypes[] | select(.name == "Apple Vision Pro") | .identifier]
| first // empty
')"
if [[ -z "$runtime_id" || -z "$device_type_id" ]]; then
echo "::notice::Skipping BDToAVPPlayer visionOS unit tests: an available visionOS 26+ runtime and Apple Vision Pro device type are required (runtime=${runtime_id:-none}, device_type=${device_type_id:-none})."
exit 0
fi
simulator_name="BDToAVPPlayer CI ${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}"
simulator_udid="$(xcrun simctl create "$simulator_name" "$device_type_id" "$runtime_id")"
cleanup_simulator() {
xcrun simctl shutdown "$simulator_udid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
xcrun simctl delete "$simulator_udid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap cleanup_simulator EXIT INT TERM
xcrun simctl boot "$simulator_udid"
xcrun simctl bootstatus "$simulator_udid" -b
xcodebuild test-without-building \
-project BluRayToVisionPro.xcodeproj \
-scheme BDToAVPPlayer \
-configuration Debug \
-destination "platform=visionOS Simulator,id=$simulator_udid" \
-derivedDataPath build/BDToAVPPlayerDerivedData \
CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

baseline.source_snapshot: tracked repository files at generation time

audit-generator-contract.description: The audit generator and its focused tests enforce deterministic inventory, classification coverage, and evidence boundaries for this bounded review.

ci-macos-app-unit.description: The maintained CI macOS scheme executes the application unit-test target.

ci-python-discovery.description: The maintained CI Python discovery lane executes these repository tests.

ci-support-diagnostics.description: The maintained CI support-diagnostics check executes this service contract suite.

ci-visionos-player-build.description: Pinned Xcode 26.5 CI regenerates the Xcode project and compiles the BDToAVPPlayer app and unit-test bundle for a generic visionOS Simulator, then conditionally runs those unit tests on a temporary Apple Vision Pro simulator when the required runtime and device type are available.

media-hardware-contract.description: Media, device, codec, fixture, and Tier 3 qualification paths retain special setup cost because they cover hardware or protocol boundaries absent from ordinary unit tests.

operator-tier3-contract.description: The installed-app UI target is an explicit clean-machine and Accessibility operator contract, not an unmaintained CI omission.

operator-visionos-contract.description: The spatial-playback targets are explicit simulator/device evidence lanes with a physical-Vision-Pro presentation boundary.

operator-visionos-sustained-playback-con.description: The qualification-gated recorder tests are an explicit simulator/device evidence lane compiled only with BD_TO_AVP_QUALIFICATION.

python-module-isolation-sweep.description: Every Python test module was executed independently; one hidden import-order dependency was reproduced and fixed without relaxing behavior.

release-security-contract.description: Release, signing, recovery, policy, and workflow assertions protect intentional operational contracts that the audit must not weaken without proof.

structured-fixture-contract.description: Audio, observability, profile, and support-diagnostics fixtures provide named structured inputs for maintained parser and service contracts.

worker-protocol-fixture-contract.description: Versioned native-worker payload fixtures preserve protocol compatibility and warning/progress/terminal-state decoding across supported versions.

high_confidence_candidates.finding: The module passed in full discovery but failed when executed alone because unittest.mock was only available after another module imported the submodule.
high_confidence_candidates.proof: The 106-module isolation sweep found the single failure; `uv run python -m unittest tests.test_process_runner` then passed all 45 tests after the focused fix.
high_confidence_candidates.resolution: Import mock explicitly from unittest and use the explicit binding.

milestone_10_disposition.outcome: Close after final review if the exact-head isolation sweep and broad gates remain green.
milestone_10_disposition.rationale: The audit produced one independently revertible import-order fix. All remaining rows are retained as valuable or accepted maintenance cost; no evidence-backed replace, consolidate, or remove candidate remains.

review_observations.finding: One isolated sweep ended with TemporaryDirectory cleanup reporting a non-empty .git directory after all test assertions completed.
review_observations.follow_up: The module passed an immediate rerun, five consecutive focused reruns, and the final 106-module isolation sweep. No code change is justified without reproducible evidence.
